segments.sn35.55:1.1: “Kathaṃ nu kho, bhante, jānato, kathaṃ passato saṃyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantī”ti?
segments.sn35.55:1.2: “Cakkhuṃ kho, bhikkhu, anattato jānato passato saṃyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
segments.sn35.55:1.3: Rūpe anattato … cakkhuviññāṇaṃ … cakkhusamphassaṃ … yampidaṃ cakkhusamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saṃyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
segments.sn35.55:1.7: Sotaṃ … ghānaṃ … jivhaṃ … kāyaṃ … manaṃ … dhamme … manoviññāṇaṃ … manosamphassaṃ … yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi anattato jānato passato saṃyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchanti.
segments.sn35.55:1.16: Evaṃ kho, bhikkhu, jānato evaṃ passato saṃyojanā samugghātaṃ gacchantī”ti.
